# Lumen Pavilion

Lumen Pavilion is a fictional glass rooftop venue that exists only in this synthetic test corpus.

## Capacity

Lumen Pavilion holds 45 guests seated or 70 guests standing.

## Cancellation Policy

A booking at Lumen Pavilion is refundable until 30 days before the event, after which half the fee is retained.

## Parking

Lumen Pavilion has no on-site parking; the nearest garage is two blocks away.
